requires: An M-VAVE FM-1 running stock V15 or official fm1_open firmware. If it runs stock V15, this page installs official Open first
Chrome or Edge on a computer, with MIDI and SysEx allowed
Anything you want to keep backed up. On official Open, M-VAVE's workbench backs up projects, samples and voices. Stock V15 has no project library for it to read

notes: Firmware 0.9.0 follows MIDI clock on any port, with start, stop, continue and song position. While it does, the screen says CLK and the tempo knob does nothing.

Saving now works on an FM-1 that has been on stock firmware. If PROJECTS says FLASH IN USE, tap SAVE and confirm: this erases four sectors of user Flash that stock firmware may have left data in. Nothing is erased until you confirm.
64 steps on four pages, the keyboard as the pattern on SEQ, conditions, projects saved in user Flash, page copy and paste.

Tested on the host and in the FM-1 emulator, including under the chip's alignment rule. 0.9.0 has not run on a device. 0.8.2 runs on one unit, with sound and USB audio; 0.8.1 before it reset in a loop.
If an FM-1 is restarting at the start-up screen: power on holding HOME until SAFE MODE shows, then connect the installer. This has not been tried on a device.
